title: INGEST Source Attestation
description: A signed human claim about the origin of a capture, made before any processing runs against it. An agent may prepare an attestation and may never sign one.

digestAlgorithm.description: MD5 and SHA-1 are excluded. Neither offers collision resistance, so neither can bind a specific artifact.

consentState.description: pending and refused both block publication. They differ in whether asking again is meaningful.

captureDigest.description: Digest of the capture, computed before preservation.

claim.description: Exactly one. A capture that is partly synthetic is synthetic. Material claimed received-capture, synthetic, or unknown-origin may never compose a curated artifact.

human.description: An attestation signed by a non-human party is IN-03.

device.description: What made the capture, where known.

origin.description: Required in practice when claim is received-capture: who it came from.

presentParties.description: Identifiable people other than the attesting party. Each carries its own consent state.
